Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of the Conference Call held for Q2 Results of FY 2027 
 
In furtherance to the intimation dated 23rd October, 2026, whereby the Company had informed the Stock 
Exchanges that the Company had arranged a Conference Call for the Un-Audited Financial Results 
(Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the Quarter and Half year ended 30th September, 
2026, on Friday, 30th October, 2026, and in compliance with the provisions of Regulation 30 of Securities 
and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please 
be informed that the Audio Recording of the said Conference Call has been uploaded on our company’s 
website and the same can be accessed at: https://www.dixoninfo.com/financial-performance under the 
head- Quarterly results (2026-27- Quarter Q2). The said recording is also available at the following link: 
Conference Call Recording. 
 
Kindly treat this as the Compliance under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulation, 2015 and oblige. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
For DIXON TECHNOLOGIES (INDIA) LIMITED 
 
 
 
 
 
_______________________
